usedFor: BlueyEmail collects form answers, and Documint fills a template when “When a form is submitted” runs “Add Content To Template”.

bestTemplate.name: “When a form is submitted” in BlueyEmail, then “Add Content To Template” in Documint
bestTemplate.why: A submitted form already holds the details a document needs, so Documint can fill its template from them.

watchOut: “Add Content To Template” needs a template to fill, so set that template up in Documint before forms arrive.
